description: This file contains utility functions for IP address manipulation, validation, and UI progress handling, used across web pages in a project.

methods.name: ip4StrToBin
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 string to its binary representation.

methods.name: ip4BinToStr
methods.description: Converts a binary IPv4 address back to string format.

methods.name: ip4MaskNum
methods.description: Calculates the mask length from a binary subnet mask.

methods.name: isIp4ValidInSubnet
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address is valid within a given subnet.

methods.name: jProgress
methods.description: Displays a progress dialog with timeout handling.

methods.name: ValidIp4Addr
methods.description: Validates if an IPv4 address is within a subnet and not reserved.

methods.name: ValidIp4AddrInDhcpPool
methods.description: Checks if an IPv4 address falls within a DHCP pool range.
